author: katekingauthor
title: Looking for artist for two pieces of character art
content: I am looking for an artist who has avalibilty right now to draw two pieces of character art. Anyone have an opening? Recs from authors are very welcome. Human artists only, absolutely no AI. Bots and clearly AI content will be blocked. Please only comment below do not DM me. Update: One piece is 2 characters, the other is 3. Will share more info privately later as this art is for my new book which is unannounced. I have no specific style in mind, but would appreciate if you posted an example of your work in the replies.

author: Sega Jenesis
title: Seeking artists for custom Pokémon scenes on binders
content: 🎨 I’m on the hunt for digital artists! 👀 I’m planning to order some custom Pokémon card binders as holiday gifts, and I’d love to commission an artist to create a scene or two for them! I’m thinking full illustrated Pokémon scenes, not just individual characters. Is it a little late in the year to be looking for holiday commissions? Maybe. 😂 But here I am anyway! Obviously, this is a PAID commission! I absolutely believe in compensating artists for their time and talent. 💚 I’d love to see portfolios, pricing, and availability.
